task_description: Fix the NullPointerException in GreetingService.greet: name=null must return "Hello, guest!". Preserve normal trimmed-name behavior and run the unchanged Maven tests.
Fix the NullPointerException in ProfileFormatter.format: a null profile or null displayName must return "User: guest". Preserve normal trimmed-name behavior and run the unchanged Maven tests.

Fix the NullPointerException in ScoreSummary.total: a null list has total zero and null elements contribute zero. Preserve ordinary, empty-list and negative-value summation behavior and run the unchanged Maven tests.

Fix the NullPointerException in SettingsReader.language: a null settings map, missing language key or null language value must return "en". Preserve trimming and locale-independent lowercase normalization of configured values and run the unchanged Maven tests.

Fix the ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException in RangeLabels.build: non-null integer arrays must become comma-separated values in input order, with no trailing comma; an empty array must produce an empty string. Preserve zero, negative and repeated values and run the unchanged Maven tests.

Fix the NumberFormatException in CountParser.parse: null, blank, malformed, out-of-int-range and negative inputs must return zero. Preserve parsing of valid nonnegative Java int values with surrounding whitespace and run the unchanged Maven tests.
